recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied Jira clarification within current build-scoped diagram sources and generated SVGs without changing unrelated SubscriptionStatus wording or broader subscription behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-47287 is an Applied/Persuasive R6 FHIR-core issue requesting Subscriptions workflow examples to say Subscription.status when showing changes to the Subscription resource status instead of ambiguous shorthand such as status=active.
initial_application: The source already contained the Jira-tagged implementation commit 53e52b22414708ad884b48ca485813ea62939f15 from PR 3967, which updated two labels in images/subscriptions/subscription-workflow-general.*. Current inspection found one remaining status=requested shorthand label in that workflow and two status: requested shorthand labels in error-recovery diagrams introduced by earlier subscription diagram work.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes and the Zulip block-vote announcement list FHIR-47287 in the approved Subscriptions block vote. source/subscriptions.html embeds the affected SVG diagrams and publish.ini lists them for publication. The SubscriptionStatus.status label in the broken-communication status response was left unchanged because it correctly names the SubscriptionStatus resource element, not Subscription.status.
reconciliation: Updated images/subscriptions/subscription-workflow-general.plantuml and its checked-in SVG, plus images/subscriptions/subscription-error-missing-event.* and subscription-error-no-communication.*, so the remaining Subscription-resource status changes use Subscription.status.
source_changes: images/subscriptions/subscription-workflow-general.plantuml and .svg: changed the handshake-success response label from status=requested shorthand to Subscription.status=requested.
images/subscriptions/subscription-error-missing-event.plantuml and .svg: changed the re-enable Subscription update label from status: requested to Subscription.status: requested.

images/subscriptions/subscription-error-no-communication.plantuml and .svg: changed the re-enable Subscription update label from status: requested to Subscription.status: requested while leaving the SubscriptionStatus.status response label unchanged.

related_jiras.note: Earlier subscription diagram work introduced the error-recovery diagrams where two remaining shorthand Subscription status labels were found; FHIR-46495 was not otherwise decided here.
A separate subscription diagram bundle-type cleanup is already represented on the combined branch and was not duplicated.
